pages.text: Spells live in spellbooks. A caster's first spell is already in their book. New spells come as $(item)scrolls$(): bind them into a book at an $(item)Inscription Table$().
pages.title: Spellbooks

pages.text: A spellbook only works $(l)equipped$(): open your accessory slots with $(l)'$() and put it in the $(l)Spellbook$() slot.$(br2)Cast with $(l)mouse side button 5$(), pick spells from the wheel on $(l)side button 4$(). Mana refills over time.

$(l)Don't right-click a scroll$() unless you mean to: reading it casts the spell once and the scroll crumbles. Inscribed, it's yours to keep.$(br2)Better robes, rings and books are found and crafted as you go.
